Static storage is returned directly; vi1101 writes entries through that pointer. The two additional vector declarations have no uses in the owned source.
The manager writes its traversal cursor even without a match. Its pre-dispatch, child guard, nested AppSRT dependency guard and final cleanup match the proposal.
The wrapper delegates to ordinary recursive JObj removal, which can defer reclamation; Remove is more accurate than unconditional Destroy.
The explicit 0x80 OR distinguishes this wrapper from ordinary removal and resolves the rendered name collision.
Premarking requires a mutable nonnull pointer, does not clear the caller's handle, and does not bypass the manager's subsequent dependency guards.
The routine premarks exact attachments, processes the current node, and recurses into children unless the instance flag stops traversal.
The final argument selects two creation paths by zero/nonzero value, supporting ByMode and distinguishing the colliding three-argument wrapper.
Header and definition agree on VecMtxPtr; four lookup attempts precede returning mutable static storage.
The enum_t selector maps 0–3 to cached vector copies, asserts otherwise, and performs no refresh.

The canonical parameter is CmQuakeKind. Its definition confirms values 1–4; constructor branches select indices 0–3, reject invalid kinds or missing models, and do not locally guard allocation results.
The bool definition and int header declaration are both preserved. Arithmetic tests only XY and adds the signed offset to each half-extent.
Strict greater-than rejection yields inclusive rectangle boundaries; scans are fighter-first, exclude exactly It_PKind_Random items, and return on the first match without entity mutation.

contradictions.reason: Accept the two .bss supersessions: source declarations and persistent cache behavior are supported, while adjacency, section extent and unused-object retention are not established.

Accept explicit deferral of all five .sdata/.sdata2 claims. Source declarations and zero/half literals cannot establish compiled section ownership, byte sizes, pool entries or address ordering. Supported literal behavior remains retained.

Accept correction of absent-pointer no-state-change wording and forced/immediate-destruction implications. Cursor writes occur without a match, and 0x80 dispatch precedes dependency guards. Ordinary and premarked tree names now preserve this lifetime distinction.
Accept dispatcher naming correction: the canonical zero/nonzero branch supports ByMode independently of the rendered collision.
Accept both cache signature supersessions. Their source types and selector behavior remain supported; removing compiled qualifiers avoids an unsupported ABI conclusion.
Accept CmQuakeKind in place of the obsolete s32 parameter description, preserving numeric mapping and constructor failure distinctions.

Accept both occupancy corrections: the test is an inclusive XY rectangle with signed margin and exact Random exclusion, not a polygon collision test. Preserve bool/int source spellings without resolving compiled ABI equivalence.

Accept owner-scoped deferral of the Shrine Route caller hazard: the condition admits zero xD4, then dereferences it before the later guard. Nullable subtree cleanup does not protect argument evaluation.

Accept owner-scoped deferral of Rainbow Cruise's descriptor-expression ambiguity. Initialization uses &gp->u.rcruise2.xC4 while update uses &gp->u with an explicit TODO; no layout-equivalence conclusion is needed for this proposal.
